'''Motesta Oasis''' was a freshwater oasis on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] located near the settlement of [[Motesta]], on the edge of the [[Jundland Wastes/Legends|Jundland Wastes]] between [[Arnthout/Legends|Arnthout]] and the [[Jawa Heights/Legends|Jawa Heights]]. The [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Brega]] sent an asset of the Empire's to assault the [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Sand People]] present there, in order to secure the location for the Imperial cause. Several water mains were temporarily damaged in order to cut off the flow of water to other Sand People settlements in the region, but were deliberately not destroyed entirely so as to ensure the water could still be tapped by the Empire after the takeover.
